info.name: Courier Backend
info.description: End-to-end API contract and negative-condition collection for the Courier backend. Run folders top-to-bottom. Login requests populate Postman's cookie jar for refresh/logout. Set resetOtp and otpCode from the development email/console output before running the valid reset/OTP verification requests. The actual dashboard path is /api/admin/analyze and the actual forgot-password path is /api/auth/forget-password.

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description: Run in order. Register/login issue the HttpOnly refreshToken cookie used by Refresh Token and Logout.

exec: const s = String(Date.now()).slice(-8) + String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)).padStart(3, '0'); pm.collectionVariables.set('customerEmail', `customer_${s}@test.com`); pm.collectionVariables.set('customerPhone', `017${s.slice(-8)}`); pm.collectionVariables.set('customerPassword', 'Password123!');

const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('status is 201', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(201)); pm.test('registration succeeded', () => pm.expect(j.success).to.equal(true)); pm.collectionVariables.set('customerId', j.data._id); pm.collectionVariables.set('customerToken', j.data.token);

const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('status is 400', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(400)); pm.test('field error returned', () => pm.expect(j.errors).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty);

const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('status is 200', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(200)); pm.test('access token returned', () => pm.expect(j.data.token).to.be.a('string').that.is.not.empty); pm.test('refresh cookie issued', () => pm.expect(pm.cookies.get('refreshToken')).to.exist); pm.collectionVariables.set('customerId', j.data._id); pm.collectionVariables.set('customerToken', j.data.token);

pm.test('status is 401', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(401));

const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('status is 200', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(200)); pm.test('access token rotated', () => pm.expect(j.accessToken).to.be.a('string').that.is.not.empty); pm.test('refresh cookie rotated', () => pm.expect(pm.cookies.get('refreshToken')).to.exist);
